g.text: Sensitivity and report criterion must be distinguished
Signal: aligned target rotation. Noise: unchanged or opposite target, pooled explicitly here; separate subtype response rates saved. d′ =
Z(hit)−Z(false alarm); criterion = −[Z(hit)+Z(false alarm)]/2. All rates use loglinear(k+.5)/(n+1) correction, including ceiling cells.95% paired
trial bootstrap; one checkpoint, exploratory multiple contrasts, no familywise significance claim.
